title: Cross-Jurisdictional Facial Recognition Misidentification by NYPD Leads to Wrongful Arrest and Four-Year Jail Time in New Jersey

behaviors.text: In 2019, facial recognition technology misidentified [person] as a suspect in an armed robbery in New Jersey.
The incident led to nearly four years of pretrial incarceration.
Despite having an alibi, Arteaga was charged based on the flawed identification.
The legal battle that followed resulted in a court ruling requiring police to reveal details about the algorithms used in facial recognition.
The process exposed significant gaps in transparency and accountability.
